jobs.description:

So, What's the role all about?

Our Customer Success team partners with enterprise clients to ensure they realise measurable business value from their investment in Proactive AI Agent. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong data analysis skills with deep customer-facing experience
, and who is comfortable owning outcomes across complex, strategic accounts.

How will you make an impact?

Own a book of enterprise and strategic customers, ensuring contract value is realized and renewal risk is proactively managed
Analyze customer, journey, and operational data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities
Translate data into clear, executive-ready insights and recommendations
Build and maintain customer success plans aligned to business outcomes and KPIs
Partner with customers to define, prioritize, and evolve AI-driven journeys that deliver measurable value
Gather and document customer business and technical requirements, and create customer-specific technical specification documents (defining scope, data inputs, logic/flows, dependencies, and success criteria) to guide implementation and delivery
Design and evolve customer journeys that leverage GenAI-based capabilities, including defining use cases, guardrails, escalation logic, and success criteria, and reflecting these requirements in technical specifications
Lead Quarterly Business Reviews, presenting performance, insights, and next-step recommendations
Coordinate cross-functional delivery with Professional Services, Product, and Sales
Support renewal and expansion conversations with data-backed business cases
Act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, balancing strategic guidance with execution

This role is ideal for someone who has:

Managed post-sale customer relationships for enterprise or strategic accounts
Owned customer outcomes, not just implementations or tickets
Used data analysis to guide customer decisions and executive conversations
Participated in renewals, expansions, or commercial planning
Presented insights and recommendations directly to customer stakeholders

Have you got what it takes?

Bachelor’s degree
Experience managing complex, customer-facing projects
Experience creating customer-facing or internal technical specifications or requirements documentation in support of implementations
Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with raw or imperfect data in Excel or similar tools
Ability to explain data-driven insights clearly to non-technical audiences
Experience working with large, process-driven organizations
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
Commercial awareness and comfort supporting renewal and expansion motions

Nice to Have

Experience in SaaS, AI, CX environments
Experience delivering or supporting executive-level business reviews
Experience designing or supporting customer journeys that leverage GenAI or large language model–based capabilities, including defining prompts, constraints, and fallback behaviors
Formal project management training or certification (e.g., PMP), applied in a customer-facing delivery or success role

jobs.title: Lead Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

Lead Customer Success Manager

So, what's the role all about?

This is where genuinely good people go to become exceptional. Our Lead Customer Success Managers already have the fundamentals nailed – they can build a relationship, read a room, and hold their own with a customer. What they’re hungry for is the next level: more range, more complexity, and the reputation that comes from proving they can handle it.

You’ll take ownership of a variety of accounts across the NiCE portfolio, building the kind of trust that means customers and partners come to you first. Programme delivery, governance, and technical execution sit with our specialist teams – your job is to be the constant thread that keeps the customer’s priorities, expectations, and experience front and centre, whatever is happening behind the scenes.

This isn’t a role for someone who’s happy where they are. It’s for someone who’s already good, knows it, and is actively building toward being one of the best – someone with a real appetite to grow their scope, sharpen their instincts, and take on the trickier conversations rather than duck them.

You’ll work closely with Sales, Delivery, Product, and every team working behind the scenes, alongside our Principal CSMs and senior leaders who’ll push you and back you as you build your own reputation. Interaction with customers spans phone, email, chat, and video, with regular face-to-face engagement where it counts, and travel to be in the room for the moments that matter.

How will you make an impact?

Build a genuine reputation across your portfolio as the person customers and partners trust to sort things out
Get comfortable in the room – business reviews, escalations, tougher conversations – and keep pushing yourself to handle bigger and more complex ones
Grow real relationships with senior stakeholders, moving from useful contact to trusted advisor over time
Translate what our programme, governance, and technical teams are delivering into language and value customers actually care about
Stay genuinely curious about new technology and AI-driven capability – learn fast, ask good questions, and build credibility as you go
Start balancing commercial acumen with customer advocacy, learning where to hold firm and where to flex
Spot risk and opportunity early, and build the judgement to know when to solve it yourself and when to pull in help
Take on renewal, growth, and expansion conversations with increasing confidence and commercial edge
Look for chances to influence beyond your own patch, and start shaping how others around you approach customer success
Own your story – usage, adoption, ROI, and what’s next – and get sharper at telling it to senior audiences
Travel to be in front of customers and partners when it counts, because some relationships are only really built in person

Have you got what it takes?

A strong track record in customer success, account management, or a similarly customer-facing role – you’ve done this well, and you want to do it at a higher level
A personality people remember – you build trust quickly and people genuinely enjoy working with you
Real ambition – you’re not looking for a comfortable seat, you’re looking for the next stretch
Comfort with technology and a genuine appetite for learning new tools and capabilities, without needing to be the expert in the room
Good commercial instincts, with the self-awareness to know when you need to sharpen them further
A growing ability to operate independently and make judgement calls, with the maturity to know when to ask for support
Strong communication skills – written, verbal, and, increasingly, in the room
Experience juggling multiple stakeholder relationships at once, without letting the quality slip anywhere
A collaborative approach – you know you don’t need to be the expert in everything, and you’re comfortable bringing in specialists who make the outcome happen

You will have an advantage if you also have:

Previous experience in a contact centre, CCaaS, or similar customer experience environment
A natural interest in AI, automation, or emerging technology, and what it means for customers
Some exposure to programme delivery, governance, or technical teams, even if you didn’t own that work directly
A background that blends commercial thinking with genuine customer empathy
Experience handling a broad or varied portfolio of accounts

What’s in it for you?

Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where some of the best people in the industry come to work. As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn, grow, and build the reputation that takes you further, with career opportunities across roles, disciplines, and locations.

If you’re already good, hungry to be exceptional, and ready to prove you belong at the next level, you may just be our next NiCEr.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Over Workspace 365

Wij maken alles eenvoudig. Workspace 365 is de intelligente werkplek die alles samenbrengt. Een centraal startpunt waar medewerkers automatisch krijgen wat ze nodig hebben. Kelly, onze digitale collega, maakt die werkplek nog slimmer: zij helpt medewerkers sneller antwoorden vinden en taken oppakken. Rust, focus en overzicht in je werkdag.
Daar hebben we mensen zoals jij voor nodig. Mensen die het verschil willen maken.

De rol: Senior Customer Success Manager

Je bent dé sparringpartner voor onze meest complexe en waardevolle klanten. Je beheert een eigen portfolio van 50 tot 60 grote accounts.
Je helpt organisaties écht voordeel uit Workspace 365 halen. Dat doe je door C-level te adviseren over hoe ze rust, focus en overzicht terugbrengen in hun werkdag, en door dat voordeel te vertalen naar meer gebruik, uitbreiding en omzet. Klanten blijven daardoor enthousiast en hun contract groeit mee, en de inzichten die je onderweg ophaalt breng je terug naar ons product team: jij bent de stem van de klant aan tafel.
Tegelijk ben je het voorbeeld voor junior en medior CSM'ers op het team, en deel je onderweg je expertise met hen. Je zet de standaard voor hoe goed customer success eruitziet, en je maakt onze aanpak slimmer, sterker en schaalbaar.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor

Het terugdringen van churn en het identificeren en verzilveren van upsell-kansen binnen je portfolio, zodat klanten niet alleen blijven, maar ook groeien.
Het zelfstandig uitvoeren van complexe onboardings en het beheren van je eigen portfolio van 50 tot 60 grote, directe klanten met een hoge MRR per klant.
Het leiden van strategische klantgesprekken op C-level en het meedenken over complexe vraagstukken.
Het adviseren van klanten over hoe ze Kelly, onze digitale collega, inzetten om adoptie en waarde binnen hun organisatie verder te vergroten.
Het signaleren van kansen voor productverbetering en het voeden van de roadmap met klantinzichten.
Het voorbeeld zijn voor junior en medior CSM'ers en het neerzetten van standaarden voor het team.
Het vertegenwoordigen van Customer Success naar intern leiderschap en externe partners.

Dit is wie je bent

Je neemt volledige verantwoordelijkheid, legt de lat hoger en grijpt kansen als je ze ziet. Je leert van anderen, volgt trends in de markt en past ze toe. Je ziet patronen, maakt complexiteit eenvoudig en stuurt aan op continue verbetering.

Dit is wat je meebrengt

Minstens 5 jaar ervaring
in customer facing rollen binnen de SaaS

HBO+ of hoger

Vloeiend Nederlands en Engels
en je leidt communicatie op organisatieniveau in beide talen
Inzicht in hoe je klanten begeleidt van onboarding, via waarde, naar groei.
Een netwerk en ervaring in customer advisory boards of strategisch account management.
Een scherpe mix van empathie voor de klant en een neus voor commerciële kansen.

Wat je krijgt

Salaris: €4.800-€6.300 bruto + bonus
Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon
€1.000 opleidingsbudget per jaar
25 vakantiedagen + 1 extra ‘You Day’ per kwartaal als je niet ziek bent!
Lunch samen. Elke dag.
Een gezellig kantoor in Nijkerk (ja, ook inclusief pingpongtafel, tafelvoetbaltafel, mario kart, en zelfs een meditatieruimte/bibliotheekje)
Een cultuur die bijna aanvoelt als een hechte vriendengroep, niet als een bedrijf. Je kent je collega's echt, en zij kennen jou.

Klaar om kennis te maken?

We drinken graag een kop koffie met je als we denken dat er een match is.
Vragen? Bel of app Julia via +31 6 11753348 of mail naar julia.vbergen@workspace365.net
Tot snel 🚀

Acquisitie is niet gewenst. Wij zoeken graag eerst zelf naar onze nieuwe collega.

Team Lead Customer Success (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Einleitung

Möchtest Du das Wachstum von Peter Park mitgestalten und unser dynamisch wachsendes Customer Success Team weiter voranbringen? Durch die Expansion unseres Teams suchen wir eine:n dritte:n Teamlead im Bereich Customer Success, der mit uns langfristige Geschäftsbeziehungen aufbaut und zur Weiterentwicklung unseres exzellenten Customer Success Departments beiträgt.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst Du eine zentrale Verantwortung: Durch strategische Weiterentwicklung, Prozessoptimierung und enge Zusammenarbeit mit Deinem Team ermöglichst Du eine erfolgreiche Skalierung und trägst direkt zur Umsetzung unserer Unternehmensziele bei. Wenn Du Lust hast, in einem dynamischen Umfeld zu wachsen und echten Impact zu schaffen, dann freuen wir uns auf Dich!

Aufgaben

Was ist Deine Aufgabe?

Strategische Evolution:
Du steigst in einer strategischen CSM-Evolution ein, in der Du die operative Umsetzung in deinem Team verantwortest und uns bei der Transformation des Customer Success Managements unterstützt.

Teamführung & Empowerment:
Disziplinarische Führung, Coaching und strategische Weiterentwicklung eines von drei spezialisierten Customer-Success-Teams. Du etablierst eine High-Performance-Kultur durch strukturierte 1:1s und die Erstellung von Best-Practice Playbooks.

Commercial Strategy:
Verantwortung für die kommerzielle Kundenentwicklung und das Erreichen ambitionierter NRR- (Net Revenue Retention) und Expansion-Ziele. Du treibst den Shift vom rein beratenden zum proaktiven, umsatzverantwortlichen Customer Success voran.

Retention & Lifecycle:
Sicherstellung einer exzellenten Customer Journey für unser Bestandsportfolio. Du verantwortest die langfristige Bindung unserer B2B-Partner und minimierst den Churn durch datenbasierte Analysen.

Prozessdesign & Skalierung:
Entwicklung und Implementierung skalierbarer Workflows. Du sorgst für klare Verantwortlichkeiten und eine strukturierte Dokumentation innerhalb des Customer Lifecycles.

CRM-Architecture:
Funktionale Ownership für die Weiterentwicklung unserer CRM-Landschaft (HubSpot/Salesforce). Du optimierst die Tool-Nutzung als zentrales Steuerungselement.

Performance & Analytics:
Steuerung des Teams anhand klarer KPIs. Du lieferst regelmäßige Reportings direkt an den Head of CSM & BizOps und arbeitest eng mit dem Commercial Team zusammen.

Schnittstellenmanagement:
Agieren als strategisches Bindeglied zwischen Product, Tech und Sales, um Kundenfeedback in Produktvorteile zu übersetzen.

Qualifikation

Deine Fähigkeiten:

Berufserfahrung:
Mindestens 5 Jahre fundierte Erfahrung im B2B Customer Success oder Account Management im Umfeld von SaaS + Hardware / Mobility, idealerweise mit Fokus auf erklärungsbedürftige Produkte.

Leadership-Expertise:
Mindestens 2 Jahre nachweisbare Führungserfahrung. Du hast Erfahrung darin, Teams durch Veränderungsprozesse zu führen und Talente weiterzuentwickeln.

Analytische Substanz & Tool-Wissen:
Du hast ein tiefes Verständnis für CRM-Systeme und für dich sind Daten die Basis für die digitale Transformation des urbanen Raums.

Kommerzielle Exzellenz:
Tiefgreifendes Verständnis für Expansion-KPIs (Up-/Cross-Sell) sowie Sicherheit in der Verhandlungsführung auf C-Level-Ebene.

Sprachkompetenz:
Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C2) sowie fließendes Englisch. Italienischkenntnisse sind ein Plus.

Unternehmerisches Mindset:
Du verstehst dich als Gestalter:in, die in einem dynamischen Scale-up-Umfeld Verantwortung übernimmt und durch klare Priorisierung den Fokus behält.

**

Work Setup:**

40 Stunden pro Woche (Vertrauensbasis)

Homeoffice Policy: 3 Tage im Office / 2 Tage remote

Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

Arbeitsort: München

Teamgröße: 5-6 Kolleg:innen

Benefits

So sieht Dein Arbeitsalltag bei uns aus

Arbeiten mit Bergblick:

Unser Büro in der Neuen Balan bietet mehr als nur moderne Ausstattung: Von der Dachterrasse aus genießt Du ein Alpenpanorama, im Sommer wird gemeinsam gegrillt, und unsere Teamevents sorgen für gute Stimmung.

Teamgeist und Impact-Kultur:

Bei uns zählt Deine Stimme! Wir leben flache Hierarchien und eine Kultur des "Du" vom ersten Tag an. Das bedeutet: kurze Entscheidungswege, direkter Austausch mit allen Ebenen und ein Team, das Dich aktiv unterstützt. Deine Ideen sind hier nicht nur willkommen, sondern werden gehört.

Freiraum für Deine Ideen:

Du übernimmst Verantwortung und kannst Deine Ideen aktiv einbringen. Wir fördern Deine Entwicklung – mit echtem Vertrauen in Deine Fähigkeiten.

Das bieten wir Dir zusätzlich

28 Urlaubstage – die Du Dir frei einteilen kannst

Modernes Apple Equipment – damit Du direkt durchstarten kannst

Betriebliche Altersvorsorge – wir denken an später

Flexibilität, die zu Dir passt

kulinarische Extras – vergünstigte Online-Kantine und wöchentlicher Team-Lunch

exklusive Rabatte – mit Corporate Benefits

Fit bleiben – Jobrad, EGYM Wellpass oder Urban Sports Club

Produktives Arbeitsumfeld – Gesunde Snacks, wie Obst, Nüsse & Müsli, sowie höhenverstellbare Tische

Weiterbildungsangebote

Innovation trifft Stabilität – Start-up Mentalität in einem finanziell sicheren Umfeld

✅ Bereit, den Markt anzuführen? Wenn du der Meinung bist, dass du die Extrameile nicht nur gehen kannst, sondern gehen willst, dann bewirb dich jetzt. Wir freuen uns auf das Gespräch mit Dir.

We are looking for a Technical Customer Success Specialist to support our Customer Success Managers (CSMs) by providing deep technical expertise across a portfolio of enterprise customers. This role is designed to scale technical knowledge across the Customer Success organization and act as a technical backbone for day-to-day account engagement.

You will work in a one-to-many model, partnering with multiple CSMs and supporting approximately 30–50 customer accounts. Your focus will be on answering technical questions, advising on best practices, and helping customers successfully design, operate, and optimize conversational AI solutions built on the Cognigy platform.

This role sits at the intersection of Customer Success, Product, and Conversational AI expertise.

How will you make an impact?

Act as a shared technical resource for CSMs across multiple enterprise accounts
Support CSMs with technical topics related to platform usage, solution design, product functionality, demos and best practice
Provide timely responses to technical questions from CSMs and, where appropriate, directly from customers
Serve as an escalation point for complex “how does this work” or “how should we do this” questions

Conversational AI & Platform Expertise

Advise customers on conversational AI best practices, including dialog design, intent modeling, and flow orchestration
Support NLU configuration, training, testing, and optimization
Provide guidance on the application of generative AI and agentic AI concepts within enterprise conversational solutions
Help customers understand platform capabilities, limitations, and recommended patterns

Contact Center & Enterprise Context

Support customers operating conversational AI solutions within contact center environments (voice and digital)
Provide high-level guidance on integrations with CCaaS, CRM, and backend systems
Help customers troubleshoot issues related to conversation behavior, routing, and experience design

Collaboration & Feedback Loop

Collaborate closely with Support, Product, Engineering, and Professional Services to resolve customer issues
Identify recurring themes, gaps, or improvement opportunities and feed insights back to internal teams
Contribute to internal documentation, enablement materials, and best-practice guides for CSMs

Scale & Efficiency

Help standardize technical guidance across the customer base
Enable CSMs to handle more technical conversations independently over time
Improve internal processes and documentation to support a growing enterprise customer footprint

Have you got what it takes?

3–5 years of experience in conversational AI, virtual agents, or intelligent automation
Experience in a customer-facing technical role (Customer Success, Solution Consulting, Technical Support, or Professional Services)
Experience supporting enterprise customers in a one-to-many or scaled model

Technical Expertise

Strong understanding of conversational AI fundamentals, including:
NLU concepts (intents, entities, training data, evaluation)
Generative AI and LLM-based conversational systems
Agentic AI and multi-step orchestration patterns
Solid understanding of contact center operations and customer service workflows
Ability to analyze conversational behavior and explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

Personal Attributes

Structured, organized, and comfortable juggling multiple customers and priorities
Clear communicator with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset
Curious and eager to stay current with advancements in conversational and generative AI
Strong sense of ownership and customer focus

You will have an advantage if you also have:

Hands-on experience with enterprise conversational AI platforms
Familiarity with Cognigy or similar products
Experience working with voice automation and CCaaS integrations

Lead Customer Success Manager

So, what's the role all about?

This is where genuinely good people go to become exceptional. Our Lead Customer Success Managers already have the fundamentals nailed – they can build a relationship, read a room, and hold their own with a customer. What they’re hungry for is the next level: more range, more complexity, and the reputation that comes from proving they can handle it.

You’ll take ownership of a variety of accounts across the NiCE portfolio, building the kind of trust that means customers and partners come to you first. Programme delivery, governance, and technical execution sit with our specialist teams – your job is to be the constant thread that keeps the customer’s priorities, expectations, and experience front and centre, whatever is happening behind the scenes.

This isn’t a role for someone who’s happy where they are. It’s for someone who’s already good, knows it, and is actively building toward being one of the best – someone with a real appetite to grow their scope, sharpen their instincts, and take on the trickier conversations rather than duck them.

You’ll work closely with Sales, Delivery, Product, and every team working behind the scenes, alongside our Principal CSMs and senior leaders who’ll push you and back you as you build your own reputation. Interaction with customers spans phone, email, chat, and video, with regular face-to-face engagement where it counts, and travel to be in the room for the moments that matter.

Build a genuine reputation across your portfolio as the person customers and partners trust to sort things out
Get comfortable in the room – business reviews, escalations, tougher conversations – and keep pushing yourself to handle bigger and more complex ones
Grow real relationships with senior stakeholders, moving from useful contact to trusted advisor over time
Translate what our programme, governance, and technical teams are delivering into language and value customers actually care about
Stay genuinely curious about new technology and AI-driven capability – learn fast, ask good questions, and build credibility as you go
Start balancing commercial acumen with customer advocacy, learning where to hold firm and where to flex
Spot risk and opportunity early, and build the judgement to know when to solve it yourself and when to pull in help
Take on renewal, growth, and expansion conversations with increasing confidence and commercial edge
Look for chances to influence beyond your own patch, and start shaping how others around you approach customer success
Own your story – usage, adoption, ROI, and what’s next – and get sharper at telling it to senior audiences
Travel to be in front of customers and partners when it counts, because some relationships are only really built in person

Comfort with technology and a genuine appetite for learning new tools and capabilities, without needing to be the expert in the room

Over Workspace 365

Wij maken alles eenvoudig. Workspace 365 is de intelligente werkplek die alles samenbrengt. Een centraal startpunt waar medewerkers automatisch krijgen wat ze nodig hebben. Kelly, onze digitale collega, maakt die werkplek nog slimmer: zij helpt medewerkers sneller antwoorden vinden en taken oppakken. Rust, focus en overzicht in je werkdag.
Daar hebben we mensen zoals jij voor nodig. Mensen die het verschil willen maken.

De rol: Senior Customer Success Manager

Je bent dé sparringpartner voor onze meest complexe en waardevolle klanten. Je beheert een eigen portfolio van 50 tot 60 grote accounts.
Je helpt organisaties écht voordeel uit Workspace 365 halen. Dat doe je door C-level te adviseren over hoe ze rust, focus en overzicht terugbrengen in hun werkdag, en door dat voordeel te vertalen naar meer gebruik, uitbreiding en omzet. Klanten blijven daardoor enthousiast en hun contract groeit mee, en de inzichten die je onderweg ophaalt breng je terug naar ons product team: jij bent de stem van de klant aan tafel.
Tegelijk ben je het voorbeeld voor junior en medior CSM'ers op het team, en deel je onderweg je expertise met hen. Je zet de standaard voor hoe goed customer success eruitziet, en je maakt onze aanpak slimmer, sterker en schaalbaar.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor

Het terugdringen van churn en het identificeren en verzilveren van upsell-kansen binnen je portfolio, zodat klanten niet alleen blijven, maar ook groeien.
Het zelfstandig uitvoeren van complexe onboardings en het beheren van je eigen portfolio van 50 tot 60 grote, directe klanten met een hoge MRR per klant.
Het leiden van strategische klantgesprekken op C-level en het meedenken over complexe vraagstukken.
Het adviseren van klanten over hoe ze Kelly, onze digitale collega, inzetten om adoptie en waarde binnen hun organisatie verder te vergroten.
Het signaleren van kansen voor productverbetering en het voeden van de roadmap met klantinzichten.
Het voorbeeld zijn voor junior en medior CSM'ers en het neerzetten van standaarden voor het team.
Het vertegenwoordigen van Customer Success naar intern leiderschap en externe partners.

Dit is wie je bent

Je neemt volledige verantwoordelijkheid, legt de lat hoger en grijpt kansen als je ze ziet. Je leert van anderen, volgt trends in de markt en past ze toe. Je ziet patronen, maakt complexiteit eenvoudig en stuurt aan op continue verbetering.

Minstens 5 jaar ervaring
in customer facing rollen binnen de SaaS

HBO+ of hoger

Vloeiend Nederlands en Engels
en je leidt communicatie op organisatieniveau in beide talen
Inzicht in hoe je klanten begeleidt van onboarding, via waarde, naar groei.
Een netwerk en ervaring in customer advisory boards of strategisch account management.
Een scherpe mix van empathie voor de klant en een neus voor commerciële kansen.

Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon
€1.000 opleidingsbudget per jaar
25 vakantiedagen + 1 extra ‘You Day’ per kwartaal als je niet ziek bent!

Een cultuur die bijna aanvoelt als een hechte vriendengroep, niet als een bedrijf. Je kent je collega's echt, en zij kennen jou.

We drinken graag een kop koffie met je als we denken dat er een match is.
